method.method_draft: First describe the image: f1 has height 2 before the midpoint and height 1 after it; f2 has the same support but the heights are reversed. Therefore infer f2(t)=f1(T-t), where T is the full support endpoint marked in the figure. Treat this as time reversal f1(-t) followed by a shift by T. Apply the Fourier rules for reversal and delay to obtain the transform in terms of F1 and the endpoint parameter.
